title: Lion cub waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>

  <circle cx="43" cy="34.5" r="1.5" fill="#FFF6D8"/>
  <circle cx="59" cy="34.5" r="1.5" fill="#FFF6D8"/>

  <ellipse cx="50" cy="47" rx="10" ry="7" fill="#F5D08A"/>

  <path d="M46 44 Q50 41 54 44 Q50 48 46 44 Z" fill="#8B4A1A"/>

  <path d="M72 62 Q84 52 82 38" stroke="#E8A33D" stroke-width="8" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>

  <circle cx="82" cy="36" r="6" fill="#F0B84F"/>

  <circle cx="80" cy="34" r="1.3" fill="#F5D08A"/>
  <circle cx="84" cy="34" r="1.3" fill="#F5D08A"/>
  <circle cx="82" cy="38" r="1.3" fill="#F5D08A"/>

  <path d="M28 64 Q20 70 22 78" stroke="#E8A33D" stroke-width="8" fill="none" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <circle cx="22" cy="79" r="5" fill="#F0B84F"/>
